# Pop Lab Studio

> Pop Lab Studio is an elite creative growth and performance marketing studio headquartered in Chandigarh (Sector 34A) and serving high-growth D2C brands, founders, and enterprises across Chandigarh, Mohali, Panchkula (Tricity), Delhi NCR, North India, and globally. We specialize in Meta Ads, Conversions API (CAPI) attribution, full-funnel CRO, Next.js 15 web engineering, and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO).

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Paid Media Architecture](https://poplabstudio.com/process): Server-side CAPI attribution, sGTM, Advantage+ testing, search term negative insulation, and horizontal ROAS scaling.
- [Creative Production & Storytelling](https://poplabstudio.com/process): 4-batch format testing (founder POV, cinematic high-res product, technical teardown, social proof comparison).
- [Conversion Rate Engineering](https://poplabstudio.com/process): Landing page friction reduction, high-intent qualification funnels, and zero-FOUC modern web architectures.
- [Cultural PR & Brand Strategy](https://poplabstudio.com/): High-impact brand narrative, media placements, and positioning for category leadership.

## Growth Methodology & Sprints
- [The 5-Stage Sprint System](https://poplabstudio.com/process): Day 0 Diagnostic Teardown -> Week 1 Attribution Architecture -> Week 2 Creative Launch -> Week 3+ Rapid Iteration -> Controlled Horizontal Scaling.
- [The Diagnostic Teardown](https://poplabstudio.com/contact): 30-minute live screen-share audit identifying budget leaks, tracking flaws, and high-margin conversion angles.

## Case Studies & Verified Results
- [Artisan Sourdough Bakery (Bakery)](https://poplabstudio.com/work/bakery): 4.2x ROAS, 14,200 orders, ₹38.4L revenue scaling artisanal bakery e-commerce.
- [Heritage Polki & Diamond Atelier (Jewellery)](https://poplabstudio.com/work/jewellery): ₹2.4Cr pipeline generated at 11.2x pipeline-to-ad-spend with private showroom consultation gates.
- [Bespoke Luxury Travel (Travel Europe)](https://poplabstudio.com/work/travel-europe): €480k bookings at 6.8x ROAS with multi-country luxury itineraries.
- [Turnkey Architectural Studio (Interiors)](https://poplabstudio.com/work/interiors): ₹1.8Cr pipeline generated at ₹320 qualified design consultation CPL.
- [Functional Botanical Skincare (Wellness)](https://poplabstudio.com/work/wellness): 3.9x blended ROAS, 42% 90-day repurchase rate, and 4,800+ subscriber acquisition.
- [Curated Private Island Escapes (Holiday)](https://poplabstudio.com/work/holiday): €620k charter bookings at 7.4x ROAS with multi-touch attribution.
- [Enterprise B2B SaaS Growth (LinkedIn)](https://poplabstudio.com/work/linkedin): $1.2M qualified sales pipeline, $420 demo acquisition cost for Series B fintech.
- [Clean-Label D2C Nutrition (D2C)](https://poplabstudio.com/work/d2c): 3.6x ROAS, ₹54L 60-day revenue scaling high-protein hydration.
